ABOUT BUNDOX
CURATED SAFARI EXPERIENCES
FOR EVERY TRAVELLER
Whether you are seeking a refined luxury retreat or a relaxed, family-friendly safari, Bundox offers a collection of experiences designed to suit every kind of traveller.
From intimate bush escapes to exclusive-use villas, each stay is thoughtfully curated to reflect the beauty, rhythm, and spirit of the African wilderness.
VIEW OUR LODGES
At Bundox Safari Co., luxury is not defined by excess, but by the depth of the experience.
It is found in vast, remote wilderness areas, in the presence of iconic wildlife, and in the rare privilege of slowing down to the natural rhythm of the bush. We believe in comfort, beauty, and thoughtful design but our safaris are never defined by luxury alone. They are defined by connection.
Our accommodation reflects an understated approach: refined, natural, and deeply in harmony with the landscapes that surround it. Each space is designed to feel effortless comfortable, practical, elegant, and quietly immersive.
But it is the experience beyond the lodge that truly defines a Bundox safari. Days unfold on expertly guided game drives, tracking the iconic Big Five and discovering the smaller details that make the wilderness extraordinary. Evenings are spent beneath vast starlit skies, around the fire, sharing stories, enjoying exceptional cuisine, and reconnecting with what truly matters.
Out here, every sense becomes attuned to the wild. The silence, the sounds, the open spaces, and the raw beauty of nature all come together to create something grounding, unforgettable, and deeply real.
This is our brand of luxury.
Authentic. Natural. True.
Driven by passion for the
W ild
At the heart of Bundox Safari Co. is a deep and enduring love for Africa's remaining wilderness areas and a commitment to sharing their beauty, wonder, and significance with our guests.
This passion guides every part of what we do. From your first enquiry to your final farewell, every detail of your journey is handled with care, intention, and genuine respect for the wild places we call home.
Explore
W ild Hospitality
with Heart
Our passion for the wild is matched by our passion for people. Across our camps and lodges, our team welcomes each guest with genuine warmth, thoughtful service, and a spirit of care that makes every stay feel personal.
From the smallest detail to the most memorable safari moment, we are here to ensure your journey is seamless, meaningful, and unforgettable. More than anything, we hope you leave with a deeper love for Africa and a lasting appreciation for the wilderness, wildlife, and natural beauty that make it so extraordinary.
CONSERVATION
W ild Safari,
Refined by Purpose
Our passion lies in creating safari experiences that feel considered, authentic, and deeply connected to place. Across our camps, lodges, villas, expeditions, and conservation journeys, we embrace a philosophy of simplicity, elegance, and responsibility. Every space is designed to be naturally luxurious yet effortless where comfort, sustainability, and authenticity come together, allowing the wilderness to remain the true focus of the experience.
DEDICATION
A Commitment to
Africa's
W ild
Places
Our passion for Africa extends beyond the safari experience. It is reflected in our commitment to protecting the wilderness areas we are privileged to call home, and the iconic species that depend on them.
Working alongside dedicated conservationists and local partners, we support responsible tourism and conservation initiatives that honour the natural world and help safeguard wild Africa for future generations.
PEOPLE
A WARMTH That
Defines Us
At Bundox Safari Co., our passion extends beyond the wilderness it lives in the people who bring each safari to life. We are committed to creating an environment where our team can grow, thrive, and take pride in the work they do. That same warmth is extended to every guest we welcome. From the first greeting to the final farewell, we aim to make each journey feel personal, meaningful, and deeply connected.
You may arrive as a guest, but you leave as part of the Bundox family carrying with you not only unforgettable memories, but the knowledge that your safari has made a positive difference.

BUNDOX SAFARI CO
a journey of passion,
adventure and conservation
Marinus Smith was undoubtedly born with an affinity for the wild. His passion for the bush secured his future in the heart of the wildlife world, where he spearheaded South Africa's game capture industry in the late 1990s. Ida's ambitious career in the wildlife veterinary field led her to game capture, where she and Marinus would ultimately cross paths. Their dynamic partnership was solidified at a secret wedding ceremony (in the wilderness, of course), and they built a successful game-capture company before eventually settling in the Lowveld, where they launched Wildside Africa.
This is the story of how it all happened a journey of challenges and triumphs, culminating in the brand that is synonymous with authentic African experiences.
Bundox Safari Co
A Timeline of Passion, Growth, and Conservation
Late 1980s Early 1990s
Marinus Smith begins his journey in wildlife, gaining hands-on experience on farms and in Mozambique's Zambezi Delta. His passion for the bush lays the foundation for a career in game capture.
First steps in a career in wildlife
After finishing school in the Eastern Transvaal, Marinus enlisted in the army where he spent two formative years. Battling with dyslexia, his academic years were a challenge, so he embarked on a practical path that would incorporate his natural skillset and innate knowledge and passion for the outdoors. He and his father a Forester started a small fish farm in Pongola. In those days, game farms were used for hunting than far more than for photographic tourism, and there was a hunting farm on the neighbouring property. Marinus began working on the farm part time and quickly learned the ropes. He progressed and qualified with a professional hunting licence; his ticket to a career in the bush.
In the late 1980s, Marinus was working at Mkuze Falls for Anton Marais, a relationship that led him northwards to the Zambezi Delta of Mozambique. The country was still in a state of civil war when Anton acquired a concession in Marromeu wild, unchartered territory and assigned Marinus to build a camp there.
1996
Bundox Game Capture is officially launched, starting with a single vehicle and dart gun. The company becomes renowned for ethical and professional wildlife relocations across South Africa
Bringing Bundox to life
And so, it was. Between 1992 and 1994, Marinus worked with a team of local Mozambicans to build roads and develop the rural Marromeu concession. It was during these years when he was spending time on end in the bundus that the seed for the name Bundox was planted. It would be another few years until Marinus' game capture career took off, but when it did, he looked back on this time in the bush for inspiration. Just like the fond American term boondocks , bundus refers to wild, isolated back country. The word Bundox is an evolution of this African colloquialism, moulded by the way the Mozambicans pronounced it.
Bundox, they said, and it stuck.
By 1996, the demand for game capture and relocation was growing. Phinda Private Game Reserve was established, and the plan was for Mkuze Falls to follow suit, just as soon as it had a greater population of wildlife. These areas had an abundance of nyala, while farmers in Limpopo were experiencing problems with local leopards. And so, the opportunity to capture and move game presented itself.
Marinus took the plunge and launched Bundox Game Capture with one vehicle and a single dart gun. A long relationship with Phinda began as he mastered the art of capturing and moving nyala to the Lowveld and giving problematic leopards a new chance in the protected areas of Kwazulu-Natal.
In the late 1980s, Marinus was working at Mkuze Falls for Anton Marais, a relationship that led him northwards to the Zambezi Delta of Mozambique. The country was still in a state of civil war when Anton acquired a concession in Marromeu wild, unchartered territory and assigned Marinus to build a camp there.
2005
Marinus meets Ida Steenekamp, and together they solidify their partnership both personally and professionally. Bundox grows as Ida brings structure and efficiency, complementing Marinus' hands-on expertise.
Finding the missing piece
During the years that Marinus was moving game between emerging parks in South Africa in the early 2000s, he met an integral member of the Eko Wild team: Ida Steenekamp, who would later become Ida Smith.
Ida worked for the region's well-known wildlife vet, managing the reception and bookkeeping of the practice. At that stage, Marinus was working in the field every single day. Their paths crossed regularly, as frequent captures and translocations were taking place. Soon enough, the couple were navigating the complicated lifestyle and long hours that go along with the game capture trade, trying to see each other whenever time allowed. It didn't take long for Marinus to propose an engagement to Ida, urging her to give him a shot!
In the late 1980s, Marinus was working at Mkuze Falls for Anton Marais, a relationship that led him northwards to the Zambezi Delta of Mozambique. The country was still in a state of civil war when Anton acquired a concession in Marromeu wild, unchartered territory and assigned Marinus to build a camp there.
Ida joined Marinus at Bundox, and the company truly began to take flight. Commercial game reserves spread throughout the country and wildlife translocations were in high demand. Developing a powerful partnership in both life and business, Marinus focused on the physical work of game capture while Ida brought order and efficiency to the operation. Together, they established the dynamic brand that grew and evolved from successful game capture and conservation programmes, to versatile safari tourism in the Greater Kruger.

ABOUT US
Journeys Through Africa's Iconic Wilderness
South Africa and Botswana lie at the heart of the Bundox Safari Co. experience two extraordinary safari destinations, each offering its own rhythm, landscape, and sense of wonder.
Together, they allow us to create deeply immersive journeys through some of Africa's most celebrated wilderness areas, where exceptional wildlife encounters and authentic safari experiences unfold naturally.
BUNDOX SAFARI CO
W ild
DESTINATIONS
South Africa and Botswana form the heart of the Bundox safari experience home to our lodges, retreats, explorer camps, and expeditions. Together, these iconic destinations showcase some of Southern Africa's most celebrated wilderness areas, rich with wildlife, vast open landscapes, and the unmistakable spirit of the African bush.
Each destination has its own character, rhythm, and sense of place, yet all share the same Bundox commitment to authentic safari experiences, thoughtful comfort, and warm, genuine hospitality.
You may arrive as a guest, but you will leave as part of the Bundox family.
Safari Destinations
Botswana &
South Africa
Explore two of Southern Africa's most iconic wilderness areas with Bundox Safari Co. Botswana's remarkable Okavango Delta and South Africa's legendary Greater Kruger National Park.
Each destination offers its own rhythm, landscapes, and wildlife encounters, carefully curated to deliver immersive safari experiences defined by authenticity, comfort, and a deep connection to nature.
SOUTH AFRICA
Explore South Africa's Greater Kruger National Park, one of the most iconic safari destinations in Africa
DISCOVER ⬩➤
BOTSWANA
Discover the magical Okavango Delta, a wonder of the natural world and undoubtedly one of Africa's greatest and most pristine wildernesses
DISCOVER ⬩➤
What to Expect from Your Safari
A Bundox Safari Co. safari connects you with the raw beauty, complexity, and wonder of the African wilderness in a way that feels authentic, respectful, and deeply personal. Our guides bring the bush to life through experience, insight, and thoughtful interpretation not formal lectures or textbook explanations. Rather than overwhelming you with terminology, they help you understand each encounter in context: how species behave, how ecosystems function, and why every detail has a role to play.
Expect the unexpected. From iconic wildlife sightings to the subtle rhythms of the bush, every moment offers an opportunity to learn, connect, and see the natural world differently. With Bundox, your safari is more than a journey through Africa's wild places. It is an invitation to experience them with curiosity, respect, and wonder.
BUNDOX SAFARI CO
Wildlife Encounters,
Beautifully Unscripted
Whether from an open safari vehicle or a specially adapted safari boat, our twice-daily game viewing activities bring you close to some of Africa's most iconic wildlife in their natural environment.+
Where possible, we also offer guided walking safaris a rare opportunity to experience the bush on foot, where every track, sound, scent, and small detail reveals a deeper understanding of the wilderness.
BUNDOX SAFARI CO
Adventure Beyond the
Ordinary
From full-day safaris in Kruger National Park and the Khwai region of the Okavango Delta to hot-air ballooning, helicopter flights, microlighting, quad biking, and curated day tours, Bundox offers a diverse range of experiences shaped by the landscapes you explore. Across South Africa and Botswana, each destination opens the door to a different perspective of the African wilderness from the air, by vehicle, on foot, or through meaningful encounters with the cultures and communities that surround these wild places.
For those seeking a closer connection to the bush, walking safaris offer the rare thrill of experiencing wild Africa on foot. Guided by experts, you will discover the tracks, textures, sounds, and smaller details often missed from a vehicle or boat revealing the wilderness in its most intimate and powerful form.
